fusions.name: Hop Along
fusions.desc: Flicks a biting speck that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Fatigued] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Way Down
fusions.desc: You spring up to 7 tiles onto the target and land with your whole weight, dealing 16 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Itch and Jink
fusions.desc: You hop 3 tiles from where you stood and settle there, with your dodge chance raised by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Fur Tenants
fusions.desc: A colony living in your fur leaps out at enemies within 4 tiles, biting for 3 damage every second. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
